description: Shared chart-timing vectors for the Unity <-> Web parity contract (Issue #612). Each case is one note of a chart with the given BPM: seconds is the float32 result of Unity NotesManager.NoteTimeSeconds (kankaku = 60/(BPM*LPB); beatSec = kankaku*LPB; time = beatSec*num/LPB, every step single precision). When endNum is present the case is a hold and endSeconds is the float32 result of Unity LongNote.EndSeconds (kankaku*endNum — a different operation order than the start time, pinned on purpose). The Web side reproduces both with the same Math.fround step order in web/tests/parity-timing.test.ts; noteTimeSec/holdEndSec of src/lib/chart are the double-precision equivalents and must agree within float32 rounding.
